results.name: sample base renders: Tasks grid, lookup-driven formula (6.5 h × 65 = 422.5), footer sum, table tabs
editing: a number cell commits on Enter and recomputes the formula; a non-number is refused; Undo restores
add a formula field: live validation disables Create on a bad formula; a good one adds a computed column
filter + sort: Status is Doing leaves 2 records; sorting Hours descending orders them; badges count the conditions
two-way link through the picker: linking Cy to a task shows on People (inverse field) and updates the Open hours rollup
kanban: columns by Status; moving a card with its Move select and by drag-and-drop updates the counts and the grid
save .ftable, reopen it from the VFS with the edits intact; export CSV to the VFS; import a CSV file as a new table
axe-core on the deeper states (field editor, filter panel, record panel, link picker, kanban): no serious/critical violations
